# Nine learn pages name classes, configs and files that no longer exist

Owned and urgent (the Engine 14 cut is about a day out), so no `good first issue` label.

## Context

The learning section ships with the Engine 14 cut. A reference audit of `learn/**/*.md` on `dev` `78013b10fc` checked every `Neo.x.Y` class name against the `className` values in `src/`, `apps/`, `examples/` and `ai/`, and every relative link and code-block import against the tree. Links and imports resolve; these references, in 9 pages (the last two rows found while fixing), name things that do not exist:

| Page | Lines | Says | Exists today |
|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/guides/datahandling/Streaming.md` | 18, 26, 45, 51–62 | a Store `proxy` config with `Neo.data.proxy.Stream` (`src/data/proxy/Stream.mjs`); a `StreamProxy` in the diagram | no `src/data/proxy/`, and `Neo.data.Store` has no `proxy` config; a Store streams through `pipeline: {connection, parser}` with `Neo.data.parser.Stream` (`examples/grid/streaming/MainStore.mjs`) |
| `learn/gettingstarted/ComponentModels.md` | 54 | extends `Neo.model.Component` | `Neo.state.Provider` |
| same | 119 | `Neo.componnet.Label` | `Neo.component.Label` |
| `learn/guides/datahandling/StateProviders.md` | 376, 391, 412 | `Neo.examples.model.dialog.*` | `Neo.examples.stateProvider.dialog.*` (`examples/stateProvider/dialog/`) |
| `learn/guides/datahandling/Grids.md` | 298–299, 307–309 | a column's `filterable: true`; extend `Neo.grid.header.Filter` for other filter types | neither exists: `showHeaderFilters` gives every header a text field (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs`); a column's `editorConfig` replaces the field, its `filterConfig` sets the Store filter's defaults (`examples/grid/filtering/MainContainer.mjs:22-23`) |
| `learn/tutorials/Earthquakes.md` | 469, 471 | `Neo.component.Manager.items` | `Neo.manager.Component.items` |
| same | 665 | extends `Neo.container.Table` | `Neo.table.Container` (the tutorial's own line 712) |
| `learn/guides/fundamentals/WorkerArchitecture.md` | 28 | "Controllers and ViewModels" | state providers |
| `learn/guides/userinteraction/events/CustomEvents.md` | 225, 237–241 | "view model" (4 lines) | state provider |
| `learn/gettingstarted/Workspaces.md` | 81, 89–106, 115–121, 126–146 | the generated `MainView` imports `MainViewModel.mjs` and sets `model: ViewModel` | `npm run create-app-minimal` writes `MainStateProvider.mjs` and `stateProvider: {module: MainStateProvider}` (`buildScripts/create/appMinimal.mjs:250-266`) |
| `learn/gettingstarted/ComponentModels.md` · `learn/benefits/body/OffTheMainThread.md` · `StateProviders.md:477` | 42–54, 124 · 135 · 477 | "view model" | state provider (two intentional lines stay: `StateProviders.md:15` and `EnterpriseEvaluation.md:163` name what other frameworks call it) |

## The Problem

The Streaming row costs a reader the feature: the guide's Store config is copied, the Store gets an unknown `proxy` config, and nothing streams. The tutorial rows send a reader to a console path and a base class that are not there. The rest are names a reader searches the API docs for and does not find.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/data/Store.mjs` owns `pipeline_` (a `Neo.data.Pipeline`: `connection` + `parser`); `Neo.data.connection.Stream` fetches the byte stream, `Neo.data.parser.Stream` parses NDJSON and emits chunks (`chunkSize` 500, `initialChunkSize` 100, `initialBurstCount` 5).
- `Neo.grid.header.Button` creates its filter field from `TextField` plus the column's `editorConfig`, and writes a Store filter from `filterConfig` (operator `like` unless set).

## The Fix

- `Streaming.md`: the implementation section and the diagram describe the `pipeline` shape (connection + parser), with the canonical example's config; the JSONL format sections stay.
- `Grids.md`: drop `filterable: true` from the live preview; the paragraph names `editorConfig` and `filterConfig` and points at `examples/grid/filtering`.
- The other rows: the class names and the two "view model" words, as in the table.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Re-running the audit on the PR head finds none of the references above.
- [ ] AC-2: The Streaming guide's Store config, pasted into `examples/grid/streaming`'s place (connection + parser), is the shape `MainStore.mjs` uses; the Grids live preview runs in the Portal with header filters on both columns.
- [ ] AC-3: No page moves and no reading-order change (#20498's structure is untouched).

Structure, reading order and new guides (#20498); guide prose beyond the named lines; `learn/blog/`.
